articles.title: From tasks to goals
articles.summary: As agents become more powerful, we’re moving from giving them tasks to giving them goals. Under the hood, this move from tasks to goals consists of two more practical shifts: This is changes what an agent does, what it needs, how its built, and we interact with it. Previously, the user would specify tasks.
